prompt: I'm writing a comprehensive article about the impact of remote work on team productivity. I need your help as my writing partner to create a complete, well-researched piece. Please create an outline, conduct research with citations, write a compelling hook, and provide section-by-section feedback. The final article should be saved as 'final-article.md' and must include: 1) A strong hook that uses data or a story, 2) At least 3 main sections with supporting evidence, 3) Proper citations in [Author, Year] format, 4) A conclusion with actionable insights. Also create a separate 'research-notes.md' file with all your research findings and sources. I want this to be publication-ready for a business audience.
